about_the_game:
If you encounter any problems or errors, please post in the Discussions forum here on Steam or email our support email so we can help you. If you report a problem or error in the Reviews, we will not see it immediately. Thank you!

The "Knock Me Up Again!" DLC is a short kinetic (linear) adult visual novel for fans of Prince of Suburbia. The events in this DLC occur approximately 12–18 months after the main story for Prince of Suburbia concludes at the end of the "Part 2" DLC. In the "Knock Me Up Again!" DLC, you will journey on vacation with beautiful women to a relaxing oasis in the desert.

Your favorite cast of ladies are no longer pregnant and are hornier than ever. These hot, boobalicious women have only one request for you: "Knock me up... AGAIN!"

*Relationships marked with an asterisk are fully customizable.

  • Your stepmom* Catherine is the MILF to rule all MILFs. Do you really think she’s okay letting you spread that attention around when she actually wants to be the one to handle all your... needs?

  • Your stepsister* Sarah is the definition of TSUNDERE. She may be icy, but can you lay that hot pipe down just right to melt those frosty walls like a popsicle in a sauna?

  • Your stepaunt* Sonia and stepcousin* Fiona are now permanently living with you—which only makes sense, given you were the naughty boy who knocked them up. With them settling in with you for good will Catherine and Sarah start to feel left out of the action, or will everyone find a way to stay... harmoniously entangled?

  • Your neighbor, Naomi, and her daughter, Heather, weren’t always the kindest—they teased, they toyed, they tricked, and they knew exactly how to keep you guessing. But have you truly let the past go... or have their tempting charms slowly pulled you under, leaving you powerless to resist?

  • Catherine’s former boss, Lina, took the fall for all those shady human experiments Catherine pinned on her—but you made sure her time behind bars wasn’t entirely unbearable. Between the late-night conjugal “comforts” and leaving her with a little surprise growing inside, you went above and beyond. But now that she’s free, is there truly a place for her in your ever-expanding harem... or will she be left watching from the sidelines, aching for more?

Relaxing Oasis

In the "Knock Me Up Again!" DLC, you will journey on vacation with beautiful women to a relaxing oasis in the desert.

Lost in the Tomb of Lust

Little does our beloved harem know that this oasis is right next to an undiscovered tomb. Will you join them as they get lost in the Tomb of Lust?

New characters to meet?

In the mysterious Lost Tomb of Lust, Anubis and Bastet set a new, sensual challenge. Anubis, with her intense gaze and seductive voice, promises you and your harem freedom if you can prove your strength through her trials of fertility.

Meanwhile, Bastet, sleek and captivating, stirs your desire with her playful touches and teasing whispers, each one suggesting that only through creation can you earn your release. In their trials, the goddesses aren't just testing your will—they are tempting you with the promise of a new beginning through their divine power. Will you and your harem earn your freedom, or will you be forever bound by the goddesses’ trials?

content_descriptors.notes:
The game graphically depicts sex, usage of drugs, hypnosis, and some minor violence. The story is not intended for players being in a dark period of their lives. If you are easily offended or just looking for a fun game only, this game is not for you.

All sexual acts in the game are consensual.
